author: Dr R Singh
text: Aanya seen in routine clinic today. Height 152.3 cm, weight 44.6 kg. HbA1c 52 mmol/mol - excellent control. Continues on MDI with insulin glargine and aspart, 4 injections per day. Dexcom G7 CGM in use. Carbohydrate counting confident. Sick day rules reviewed today (22/04/2026).

author: Dr P Edwards
text: Reviewed Jacob in clinic. HbA1c on capillary cartridge today measured at 79 mmol/mol - ongoing struggle with compliance. BP elevated at 134/82 - will reassess. On Tandem t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ algorithm and Dexcom G7 CGM. Discussed dietary modification (he is eating frequent takeaways) and offered referral to dietitian. Smokes 5 cigarettes per day; smoking cessation advice offered and date 14/05/2026 recorded - declined formal referral to stop-smoking service today. Sick-day rules revisited.

author: Dr R Singh
text: Ethan (6y) admitted via ED on 11/06/2026 with new-onset Type 1 diabetes. Did not meet DKA criteria on admission (initial pH 7.32, standard bicarbonate 19.5 mmol/L). Stabilised on MDI. Enrolled on TEPLI-TRIAL paediatric immunotherapy programme; first teplizumab infusion 26/06/2026. Carbohydrate counting level 3 education delivered to parents by paediatric dietitian on 24/06/2026 (within 14 days of diagnosis - process complete). Family doing well.

author: Dr P Edwards
text: Sumaiya seen in T2 clinic. HbA1c 68 mmol/mol, total cholesterol 5.8 mmol/L. Albuminuria stage: microalbuminuria (ACR 6.7 mg/mmol). Continues on metformin 1g BD; semaglutide 0.5 mg weekly added 3 months ago. Strong family history of T2DM. Non-smoker, non-vaper. Dietary advice reinforced. Sick day rules reviewed (02/05/2026). Influenza vaccination recommended (later given in November).

author: Dr R Singh
text: Naomi reviewed in clinic. HbA1c 62 mmol/mol. Coeliac disease confirmed in June 2026; gluten-free diet prescribed and family supported by paediatric dietitian. Will need additional dietitian appointment for coeliac and diabetes management - appointment scheduled for 14/12/2026. Sick-day rules reviewed today.

author: Dr P Edwards
text: Owen seen in genetics-shared paediatric diabetes clinic. HNF1A-MODY confirmed. HbA1c 47 mmol/mol - well managed with diet alone, no medications required. Lifestyle and dietary modification reinforced. Non-smoker, non-vaper.

author: Dr P Edwards
text: Aisha attended for routine clinic. HbA1c 60 mmol/mol. Tandem t:slim X2 pump with Control-IQ - excellent technical engagement. Levothyroxine 75 mcg daily for autoimmune hypothyroidism (diagnosed 2022). Carbohydrate counting confident. Non-smoker, non-vaper. Transition pathway initiated - final paediatric appointment 12/01/2027.

author: Dr R Singh
text: Lily (6y) seen in clinic. HbA1c 51 mmol/mol. Medtronic 780G hybrid closed loop, Guardian 4 sensor; excellent automated control. Carbohydrate counting performed by parents. No additional concerns.

author: Dr P Edwards
text: Daniel admitted on 22/11/2026 with acute diabetic ketoacidosis. Initial blood gas at admission: pH 7.08, standard bicarbonate 9.4 mmol/L, blood glucose 28 mmol/L. Severe DKA. Managed per ISPAD guideline. Did not require hypertonic saline, mannitol or bicarbonate infusion (no cerebral oedema suspected). Discharged on 25/11/2026 after stabilisation. Precipitant: missed insulin doses (school exam stress). Sick day rules revisited prior to discharge. Will follow up in clinic.

author: Dr P Edwards
text: Daniel seen post-admission. Family engaging well with diabetes nurse follow-up. HbA1c machine in clinic was offline today so no formal HbA1c measured - will be checked at next visit. Continues on basal-bolus MDI (3 injections daily for now). Discussed CGM offer; family preferring to defer until summer.

author: Dr R Singh
text: Imani (12y) reviewed in clinic. HbA1c 74 mmol/mol - challenging control. Background of ADHD diagnosed 2022. Mother and patient discussed difficulties around insulin omission. Annual psychological screening completed today (12/06/2026): patient reports significant mood difficulties; assessed as REQUIRING additional psychological support outside routine care. Referred to diabetes-MDT psychologist; appointment offered for 09/09/2026 (attended). Eye screening booked at hospital diabetic eye screening service for 08/10/2026 - result awaited. Sick-day rules reviewed.
